name: Bolton
tagline: Historic charm at the foot of the Willamette.
description: Known for its tree-lined streets, classic Craftsman homes, and proximity to the Willamette River, Bolton offers a blend of history, character, and convenience just minutes from downtown West Linn.
narrative: Bolton sits on the hillside just above the Willamette River, one of West Linn's oldest and most characterful pockets. The streets are lined with Craftsman bungalows and early cottages, many on generous lots with mature trees, and a short walk often leads to a river view or a tucked-away staircase down toward the water.

It rewards buyers who want personality over polish. Some homes are beautifully kept, others are honest fixers waiting for the right hands, and the range of prices reflects that spread. If you're buying your first home in West Linn, or you want a project with good bones in a walkable historic setting, Bolton is usually the first neighborhood worth a serious look.
rightFor: First-time buyers who want into West Linn schools without a luxury price tag
Renovators looking for character homes with room to add value
Buyers who value walkability and river access over square footage

name: Willamette
tagline: The heart of West Linn's original downtown.
description: Rich in history and community spirit, Historic Willamette features charming homes within walking distance of local restaurants, coffee shops, boutiques, parks, and year-round community events.

name: Robinwood
description: Robinwood offers established neighborhoods, excellent commuter access, nearby shopping, and a wide variety of home styles, making it one of West Linn's most convenient locations.

name: Sunset
tagline: Peaceful streets with sweeping territorial views.
description: An established neighborhood known for mature trees, larger lots, and a quiet residential atmosphere while remaining close to schools, parks, and shopping.

name: Cascade Summit
tagline: One of West Linn's premier master-planned communities.
description: Beautifully maintained streets, neighborhood parks, and thoughtfully designed homes have made Cascade Summit one of the city's most sought-after neighborhoods for years.

name: Rosemont Summit
tagline: Luxury living surrounded by parks and trails.
description: Featuring upscale homes, manicured streets, and excellent access to shopping, recreation, and top-rated schools, Rosemont Summit continues to attract buyers seeking both elegance and convenience.

name: Marylhurst
description: Bordering the Willamette River, Marylhurst offers a peaceful setting with mature trees, custom homes, and a blend of privacy and natural beauty.

name: Hidden Springs
description: Winding streets, mature landscaping, and thoughtfully designed homes create a quiet retreat while remaining just minutes from everyday conveniences.

name: Parker Crest
tagline: A welcoming neighborhood with lasting appeal.
description: Parker Crest combines established homes, tree-lined streets, nearby parks, and convenient access throughout West Linn.

name: Barrington Heights
description: One of West Linn's premier luxury communities, Barrington Heights is known for custom estates, larger homesites, and spectacular territorial and mountain views.

name: Skyline Ridge
description: Perched high above the valley, Skyline Ridge offers custom homes, scenic outlooks, and a peaceful residential environment.

name: Cedaroak
description: Cedaroak blends established neighborhoods, mature trees, and proximity to the Willamette River, offering a relaxed lifestyle with convenient commuter access.

name: Savanna Oaks
tagline: Quiet streets surrounded by natural beauty.
description: Savanna Oaks features newer homes, neighborhood green spaces, and a peaceful setting that appeals to buyers seeking a balance of privacy and convenience.

name: Hidden Creek
tagline: A tucked-away enclave with upscale appeal.
description: Hidden Creek offers beautifully maintained homes, mature landscaping, and a quiet setting ideal for those seeking privacy without sacrificing accessibility.

name: Tanner Creek
description: Known for its wooded surroundings, spacious homes, and tranquil atmosphere, Tanner Creek offers a secluded feel while remaining close to schools and amenities.

name: Stafford Hamlet
tagline: Luxury country living just minutes from the city.
description: Offering rolling hills, equestrian properties, hobby farms, and custom estates, Stafford Hamlet provides a rare opportunity to enjoy rural living while remaining close to West Linn, Lake Oswego, and Portland.

name: Pete's Mountain
tagline: Scenic acreage, privacy, and panoramic views.
description: Located just south of West Linn, Pete's Mountain is known for its rolling hills, vineyards, luxury estates, and expansive countryside views. Residents enjoy larger properties, custom homes, and easy access to West Linn, Wilsonville, Lake Oswego, and Oregon City. For buyers seeking privacy, space, and a connection to nature, Pete's Mountain offers one of the area's most distinctive living experiences.
